title: E2E motion guide: verify guided-object positions in published SWF
description: Extend motion-guide.spec.ts to add a pixel-position oracle confirming the guided object follows the correct path positions at key frames in Ruffle. Currently the test only checks that the guide layer shape is absent from the SWF, not that the tweened object positions are correct. getTweenedFrame correctly samples the guide path via getGuideLayerPath — verify this end-to-end.
